text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I visited the shopping mall
to pick out some new clothes,
I heard a familiar voice.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Flight-san, thank you so much!
Mayano totally loves those clothes!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Next time, I'll style them just like you taught me
and show off Mayano's full-blown mature charm☆

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I can't wait.
We'll go on a mature date together.
Like a little cafe tour, or—oh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our eyes met, and we exchanged brief greetings.
It seemed she had come to help
Mayano Top Gun pick out clothes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, I'd heard rumors
that North Flight was quite knowledgeable
when it came to fashion.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
This mall has so many shops,
and the displays are arranged so thoughtfully...
It's delightful just looking at them.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: For example, that top over there—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As she pointed, I noticed a woman standing nearby
with a troubled expression on her face.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Whoa. That lady over there
looks super mature!
That dress suits her so nicely, she looks amazing~!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes. She incorporates trends effortlessly,
and has an adult-cute aesthetic—
like an elegant blossom!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ...And yet.

text_block_list.name: Store Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Ah, excuse me, miss! That item
comes in other colors too~
If you'd like, I can bring them right over...

text_block_list.name: Stylish Woman
text_block_list.text:
...No, thank you.
I've had enough for today... I'll come back another time.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. What a coincidence, meeting two days in a row.
Did you come to look for clothes today as well?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as I was about to say I was taking a walk, I noticed.
The stylish woman from yesterday
was standing at a nearby shop.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... What are the odds!
Running into that lady from yesterday too.
...Though it's strictly one-sided on our part.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I was just in that shop a moment ago,
and she was trying on quite a few outfits.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
They all looked lovely on her,
but it seemed like she couldn't find
anything that truly satisfied her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I glanced over at the woman.
She seemed to coordinate her clothes flawlessly like a textbook model,
so I wondered... what could be troubling her?
choice_data_list: Did you try talking to her?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With North Flight's fashion sense,
I thought she might be able to offer some advice.
However, North Flight shook her head.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Right now is her time to think.
...Still, if our paths cross again,
I would love to have a chat with her.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Time to search for
'what she needs right now.'

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san, what kind of clothes have you bought
recently? Conservative?
Or perhaps casual, or formal?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I gave it some thought before answering.
Lately, I've mostly been buying clothes
that prioritize mobility to match my work.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
You really love your work, don't you?
Just looking at how you're dressed right now,
you seem so radiant and full of life.
choice_data_list: Can you tell all that just from my clothes?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Not everything, of course,
but there are so many facets of 'oneself'
hidden within one's clothing!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Anyone can study trends and cultivate taste,
but understanding 'who you are right now'
can actually be surprisingly difficult.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Were those words meant for that woman just now?
Glancing in the direction of the shop,
North Flight gave a gentle smile.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
How to adorn oneself,
how to express one's charm.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I adore seeing people put in earnest effort
and contemplate those very questions.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I hope she finds her answer.
Because once she does...
I know she'll shine even brighter.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I felt like I had caught a glimpse of
the profound depth of choosing clothes...
That was how my day ended.
